subject: Air freight quote to NBO
body:
Hi,

Please quote your cheapest air freight option to NBO (Nairobi, KE), all-in in EUR, including truck pickup from our site at 36241 (Fulda), Germany, to the airport. The shipment is ready for pickup on 2026-11-24.

Textile samples: 5 pieces, 721 kg gross, 3.50 cbm. Each piece measures 100 x 100 x 70 cm. Our packing specification is attached.

Thanks

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a specified shipment to Nairobi.
